parties.name: Labour
parties.summary: Labour proposes recruiting 6,500 new expert teachers, introducing free breakfast clubs in every primary school, placing mental health professionals in every school, reforming the curriculum and assessment system, and ending VAT exemption for private schools to fund state education investment.

citations.quote: Labour will provide access to specialist mental health professionals in every school, so every young person has access to early support to address problems before they escalate.
Labour will end the VAT exemption and business rates relief for private schools to invest in our state schools.

results.headline: Labour pledges 6,500 new expert teachers in key subjects
results.quote: Labour will recruit an additional 6,500 new expert teachers.

results.headline: Labour MP challenges Conservatives on tuition fee legacy
results.quote: Given that plan 2 tuition fees were introduced by the Conservatives in 2012, that they froze the repayment thresholds in 2016 and that they abolished the maintenance grants, was that fair then?

parties.name: Conservative
parties.summary: Conservatives propose building on existing school improvement records, introducing the Advanced British Standard for 16-19 education, requiring schools to ban mobile phones during the school day, and funding 100,000 apprenticeships partly through curbing poor-quality university degrees.

citations.quote: We will require schools to follow our guidance on banning the use of mobile phones during the school day

We will introduce the Advanced British Standard, a new approach to 16-19 education which will build on the best of A Levels and T Levels. We will end the artificial and damaging divide between academic and technical education which has persisted for far too long.

results.headline: Conservatives claim children are best readers in the West
results.quote: We recruited record numbers of teachers to help our children become the best readers in the West.

results.headline: Conservative MP: Labour first introduced tuition fees
results.quote: I must be suffering from some sort of political amnesia, because I was absolutely convinced that it was a Labour Government that introduced tuition fees in the first place. Maybe the Minister will correct me.

results.headline: Conservative MP: Labour has now admitted student loans system is broken
results.quote: In January, the Chancellor was saying that the student loans system was 'fair and reasonable'. She now admits 'as of yesterday' that it is broken. In one sense, we have won this debate even before it started.

parties.name: Liberal Democrats
parties.summary: Liberal Democrats propose increasing school and college funding per pupil above inflation, placing a dedicated mental health professional in every school, introducing a Tutoring Guarantee for disadvantaged pupils, and reforming teacher recruitment and retention through a new workforce strategy.

citations.quote: Put a dedicated, qualified mental health professional in every primary and secondary school, making sure all children and parents have someone they can turn to for help, funded by increasing the Digital Services Tax on social media firms and other tech giants.

Increase school and college funding per pupil above the rate of inflation every year, and end the scandal of crumbling school and college buildings by investing in new buildings and clearing the backlog of repairs.

results.headline: Lib Dems pledge dedicated mental health professional in every school
results.quote: Putting a dedicated, qualified mental health professional in every school.
